Nyngkong eh la buh Vanga shapoh dkhar. Nangta ki wan rah sha Shillong kum u Assistant to the De puty Commissioner, Khasi bad Jaihtia Hills District, kumba khot i'a ka ri jong ngi ha kito ki sngi, bad ruh knrn u Assistant Political Officer, Khasi States, kiba pyn- loug lang ia ka distrik.
